title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-09
content:
Morning log (9 Apr 2026) - quick brain dump and checklist.

PRD edits:
- Updated rollout section per SRE feedback: added circuit-breaker fallback and explicit latency SLOs for 95th and 99th percentiles.
- Need to add matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted behavior when model variant fallback occurs (who owns routing policy). TODO: write short table mapping policy owner (product, infra, customer) — placeholder in PRD.
- Clarify quantization recommendation language: replace vague 'low cost' phrasing with concrete cost delta estimates (20-35% token cost reduction). Reach out to Applied ML for numbers (Ava).

Stakeholder follow-ups:
- Diego: sync after standup about canary rollback criteria (1pm). Prep list of observable signals: error-rate spike >0.5%, p95 latency > SLA+40ms, degraded output-quality (eval set regressions).
- Legal: awaiting final wording on data retention in Private deployments. Add to next weekly agenda if not in by EOD Thursday. Contact: Priya.
- Sales/CS: quick one-pager for key customers about Dedicated burst policy — draft by EOD (use existing dedicated/commit notes).

Launch checklist (high level):
- Pre-launch:
  - Finalize PRD + publish to Confluence (me) - target today
  - QA run with canary traffic profile (SRE) - scheduled Tue
  - Security review sign-off (Security) - pinged last week, reminder today
  - Release notes draft (internal + external) - start bullets now
- Day-of:
  - Monitoring runbook pinned in Slack channel + pager config verified
  - On-call rotation notified (SRE + Product PM buddy)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Do we want an explicit cost telemetry metric surfaced in Console for quantized models? (Yes probably) -> add to product backlog with priority P2.
- Investigate low-traffic perf: continuous batching might hurt 99th percentile for short prompts. Add experiment ticket and loop in Serving Runtime.
- Quick UX ask: make default view for rollouts show current active variant + recent fallback events. Logged in product backlog.

TODAY's top 3:
1) Publish PRD edits + share with SRE/A-ML for signoff
2) Draft Dedicated burst one-pager for CS
3) Prep canary rollback criteria doc for sync with Diego (attach sample metrics)

Misc quick reminders:
- Grab metrics from observability for model-family X (last 7 days) before the sync. Location: console -> models -> X -> metrics.
- Call with partner integrations postponed to next week; move to Tuesday slot.

End-of-day note: if PRD not greenlit, escalate to head of Product (Maya) and schedule a 30-min alignment slot tomorrow morning.

Random scratch: "If fallback to smaller model triggers more often than 1% of requests, auto-escalate to operations." Keep as draft rule.

---
Hand-off: sending this to Ava after edits for numbers and to Diego after I've added rollback metric bullets.
